title: Archive Intro
description: The italic standfirst that opens every Tour Operator archive — live's `.lsx-to-archive-description`, 18px italic inside the warm intro band. It opens with a brand-500 drop cap in the heading face, which is the one place on the site that device appears and the reason this is a style rather than two attributes on a paragraph. The drop cap itself lives in assets/styles/core-paragraph.css: live gates it at 900px and up, and an `@media` block inside a `css` field is unwrapped rather than honoured, so the query would apply the cap at every width. Colour comes from the band around it.
